budget_1_2_star.sourceTitle: Hotel Data for Researchers & Academics — HOTEVI
budget_1_2_star.evidenceText: The HOTEVI research table shows Berlin | Germany | 431 hotels | Budget $70. The page defines Budget as the 1-2-star grouped tier and describes the figures as average nightly rates in USD by star tier; occupancy and tax treatment are not stated.
budget_1_2_star.referencePeriod: Monthly average; HOTEVI citation identifies the Hotel Price Index retrieval as July 30, 2026.
budget_1_2_star.searchQuery: site:hotevi.com/research Berlin Germany HOTEVI hotel price index budget mid-range luxury
budget_1_2_star.reason: Exact city/country row, positive USD grouped budget value, source-defined class, and monthly statistic are present. This is a grouped proxy, not an observed two-adult product tier.
